independence: Geometry, mixed element matrices and physical-field evaluation execute native NeoPZ components. Exact lateral zero-flux elimination and sparse factorization are performed by a separate driver. This is a classical conforming reference, not the NeoPZ MHM controller and not the quadrilateral Q1 MHM discretization.
sampling: Pixel-center and x=199 profile samples are one-sided display values. All errors and intergrid differences use integrated physical fields.
reference_accuracy: Self-refinement differences are reported; no computed reference is identified with the exact reservoir solution.
